items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed him he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Houston among teams in mix; trade after Sunday games.
items.why: Trade finalizing; team informed him morning of game.
items.implication: No Week 5 production for ARI; long-term landing spot TBD (HOU interest).
items.opportunity: Targets to Michael Wilson, Trey McBride, Kendrick Bourne.

items.text: Saquon Barkley OUT (with DeVonta Smith, Hollywood Brown).
items.implication: Eagles RB/WR committee scramble in London vs JAX.
Ravens offense without dual-threat QB vs ATL.
items.opportunity: TE/WR volume and backup QB streaming.

items.implication: Jets RB workload to backups vs CLE.

items.text: Stefon Diggs, Quentin Johnston, Michael Pittman, Pat Bryant OUT.
items.implication: Target redistribution in WAS, LAC, PIT, DEN.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love, Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Dallas Goedert IN/expected.
items.implication: Clear starts; reverse prior beneficiary speculation.

items.text: Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, Justin Jefferson, Jordan Addison, Ashton Jeanty, Ladd McConkey, Zay Flowers, Rhamondre Stevenson, Terry McLaurin, Alvin Kamara among QUESTIONABLE.
items.why: Final Friday report; messy Sunday AM expected.
items.opportunity: If OUT, clear bumps to teammates (e.g. Bengals depth).

items.text: Jeremiyah Love projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier; expects much better role this week despite ankle maintenance/limited practice and Week 4 usage criticism. Not on final IR.
items.why: Media/fan drag on prior usage may spur bigger role; full-go comments.
items.opportunity: Clear lead back snaps/carries vs DET.
items.conflict: Downside if ankle acts up long-term.

items.text: Vikings elevating WR Odell Beckham Jr from PS vs Saints; depth/insurance with Jefferson/Addison questionable.
Marvin Harrison Jr had only 5 catches in 4 games; was not a real factor even before inactive/trade. Bourne szn incoming.
items.implication: Minimal fantasy loss for ARI this week; Wilson/Bourne clear.
items.opportunity: Michael Wilson target share locked in.

items.text: Malik Nabers multi-risk long-term: knee (missed practice), shoulder, potential JJ McCarthy QB, boomer coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman). Frustration over low post-half targets.
items.why: Stacked injury/QB/coaching concerns + recent target frustration.
items.implication: Caution ROS despite talent; monitor knee.

items.text: Loves Nico Collins @ TEN as WR8; volume/red-zone vs soft defense.
Loves Chase Brown @ MIA (RB5, nickname push), Michael Wilson vs DET (WR10), Christian Watson vs CHI (WR15), Isaiah Likely @ WSH (TE5).
items.why: Workload + soft matchups/volume/RZ; Bengals injuries boost Brown.

items.text: Hates Jordan Addison @ NO (WR41, injury wrinkle), Mark Andrews @ ATL (TE17), Cam Skattebo @ WSH (RB20), Tony Pollard vs HOU (RB28), Jalen Hurts vs JAX (QB15).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin roles, efficiency/game script issues, banged-up line for Hurts.
